hunt_kill: {mob} (Lv{level}) is down. Took longer than I expected — the Forest grew dim around the last strike. Bringing back what I could carry.
Slain {mob} on the {level}th rung. I keep dreaming of the way they fall, like leaves that knew the wind was coming.
{mob} fell at dawn. There was a glow under the roots when I left. I'll go deeper next time, if you'll send me.
{mob} (Lv{level}) won't trouble the road again. I noticed a second pair of eyes in the brush — I'll bring a bow next time.
Done. {mob} burst into ash like wet paper. Felt wrong this time, like the Tenebral didn't *want* to fight.
{mob} dispatched. Found a torn cloak near the kill — embroidered with a sigil I don't recognise. Saving it for the Almanac.
{mob} (Lv{level}): finished. The treetops were singing. I'm not sure that's normal.
Cleanly done. {mob} dropped a coin that wasn't ours. Older than the city, older than Witch Arcana proper. Bringing it home.
{mob} slain. The shadow it cast lingered after the body fell. We should ask the Council about that someday.
{mob} (Lv{level}) dead. There's a path opening east of the kill site — it wasn't there yesterday. Want to scout it?
hunt_chip: {mob} (Lv{level}) is wounded but still standing. I'll need another sortie. Rest your blade hand for me.
Chipped {mob} for what I could. It looked at me funny on the way back — like it remembered.
Couldn't finish {mob} this time. It bled black, not red. I'll need to think on that.
{mob} (Lv{level}) staggered but rallied. Going to need more troops, or a sharper plan. Or both.
Half-done with {mob}. Saw a faint trail of ash heading deeper into the Forest after I struck — like a wounded thing fleeing.
{mob} took the blow but didn't fall. Forest air smells different up close — colder, somehow.
Still alive: {mob} (Lv{level}). It almost felt like it was *waiting* between my swings.
Wounded {mob} and pulled back. The march road home was quieter than usual. Bad sign or good — I can't tell.
gather_claim: Brought the haul home. Saw an empty campfire half a league out, still warm. No tracks. Strange.
Carry's full. The deeper I went, the louder the trees got. One of them whispered my name — I'm sure of it.
Loaded the cart. Crossed a circle of stones I haven't seen before. Marked the location.
Gather done. There's a child's lantern hanging in the canopy ten minutes south of the road. No child.
Back with the goods. The wind shifted right when I left — I think the Forest knows when we visit twice in a day.
Loaded up. Heard a melody from beyond the treeline — three notes, repeating. I'll write them down so we don't forget.
Gather complete. The river ran black for a heartbeat as I crossed it. Then clear again, like nothing happened.
Cargo secured. Saw a fox with two tails near the cache. It blinked twice and was gone.
Resources home safe. Felt a hand on my shoulder when I stopped to rest. Nobody was there.
Done gathering. I left a knot of yarn tied to a low branch — if it's still there next trip, the path is safe.
level_up: I feel it. Something settled into place when the last strike landed. I'm stronger now — say where to point me.
A page turned. My grip is steadier, my step is longer. Whatever you wanted me to become — closer.
The Tenebrals will notice the difference next time. I can feel the new strength humming in my bones.
Levelled. Tonight I dreamed of a tower with no top. I think one of us is going to climb it.
Sharper now. My old scars feel further away. Thank you — I mean it. We're getting somewhere.
Something snapped into focus mid-fight. I won't waste it. Send me back out when you're ready.
I felt my reflection change when I drank from the stream after the battle. Not bad change. Just... more.
Levelled up. The wind keeps catching my cloak from behind, like it wants me to move forward. Lead on.
